title: Indicator: Stochastic — non-blocking review follow-ups
description: Non-blocking finding from pr-reviewer's review of PR #12 (indicator-stochastic), tracked here per CLAUDE.md's autonomous-pipeline rule so it isn't lost once that PR merges.

checklist.step: _validate_period's int/bool/range guard in stochastic.py duplicates the identical inline check in app/indicators/ema.py::ema(). force_index.py avoided this by delegating to ema() directly, but stochastic.py can't (it's SMA-, not EMA-, based) — extract a shared _validate_period-style helper once a third indicator needs the same check, rather than a third copy-paste.
